processes.daily_credit_report_forwarding: Forwarding the daily credit report from credit to desk staff, with no analysis.
processes.daily_position_report_approval: Reviewing and approving or answering questions on the daily position report (DPR) and its P&L or GL adjustments.
processes.deal_book_correction_and_transfer: Correcting deal fields (price, counterparty, leg type) or moving or flipping deals between books in Tagg/Sitara on request, then confirming completion.
processes.origination_credit_grant_reconciliation: Reconciling origination credit claimed against credit granted and fixing the difference.
processes.risk_book_and_postid_info_sharing: Supplying books, post ids, or P&L support lists to other groups on request.
processes.system_access_request_approval: Approving system access requests as the designated data approver.
